milestone: Signature guidance during final identifier argument editing
implementation: Recognize only a final bare identifier argument with the cursor inside or at its end, accounting for an implicit pipeline parameter
Project the request-local argument list to its supplied prefix and reuse the validated-callee snapshot; never use a successful projected typed program as ordinary analysis
Validate callee and earlier arguments without claiming the active name resolves or matches the expected type
Preserve source buffers, disk files, actual-program diagnostics and normal hover; no placeholder value or source edit is generated

cases: Partial identifiers with suffixes and trailing unclosed calls, first/final names, resolved names and an active name whose actual type is wrong
Named, factory-result and indexed/piped signatures retain correct active parameters
Invalid earlier arguments, nonfinal names, compound/member expressions, extra arguments, unknown callees and noncallable shadows do not receive projected guidance
Imported aliases/current dependency return-type overlays update signatures; ordinary hover on the actual unresolved name still returns null
Source isolation, no query diagnostic publications and existing normal/sanitizer signature, hover and complete protocol regressions
qualification.release_package: Current native-editor-tools-package and kalandra built; native-editor-tools-install passed (3.95 seconds)

Partly typed expression names receive native completion
